records.source: Exosphere: SpaceX does not publish header volumes. Sized (20 t at O/F 3.6) for the observed ~19 s three-two-one landing burn (SpaceX Flight 14 timeline) flown by the powered-descent guidance to water contact with margin; 30 t (sized for the former slow burn on subcritical crossflow drag) put the CoM ~4 m ahead of the flaps neutral trim. Stations from public cutaway descriptions (LOX header in the nose, CH4 header inside the LOX tank)
records.conditions: capacity and station of each embedded header tank; the same mass is removed from the main tank so the stage total is unchanged
records.uncertainty: capacity ±50%; station ±2 m; tied to the estimated landing profile

records.conditions: 22.5..35 degrees N, 161..140 degrees W. All 15,120,000 native cells sampled, no skipped or missing cells; elevations -7024..-66.55 m. This geographic operating domain covers both independently propagated contacts: isolated Earth at 23.137 N, 157.901 W and the moving-Solar-System loaded preview at 22.528 N, 160.292 W. It replaces the old 25..35 N, 165..140 W coverage, excluding Kauai and Nihoa rather than asserting measured Flight 14 targeting. Contact-speed, attitude, resource and water-load acceptance limits remain unchanged.
records.uncertainty: Finite 15 arc-second geographic screen only; not a measured landing target, coastal navigation dataset or seabed collision mesh. Sea-surface and water-load approximations remain unchanged.
